_meta.title: NYU Path — concept → code retrieval index
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable crosswalk: concept -> current-system doc -> spec -> implementation files -> tests. Query with jq/grep to scope an audit or locate code before deep-diving. One row per current-system concept doc.
_meta.lastPatched: 2026-07-15 — corrected stale ALL_NYUPATH_TOOLS=24 note-references to 22 (FOSE drop) and recorded the new frozenContractManifest guard. Rows are otherwise the 2026-06-26 snapshot; regenerate after large changes.
_meta.method: Generated by a fan-out workflow (one agent per current-system subsystem). Every impl/test path was verified to exist on disk; rows where a path could not be confirmed are marked verified:false with the reason in notes.
_meta.caveat: A point-in-time snapshot. The working code is the source of truth — re-verify a path before relying on it, and regenerate this file after large changes (see Docs/README.md).
